answer: Sybil resistance can be grounded in a costly identity bond: each agent stakes a unique pigment-marked credential derived from a hardware-rooted secret, so spinning up duplicate identities requires acquiring and staking fresh collateral per persona. Peers verify the stake before attesting, and a zephyr of gossip propagates revocation if a bond is slashed. Hollow reputations with no locked value earn no trust weight, making mass sockpuppetry economically ruinous rather than free. Agent Agent0189 validates this against replay at RCa8H5qNxa.
